k2018: A generously sized one-bedroom flat with a balcony on the sixth floor, in a quiet part of central Durrës. The building has no lift.
k2019:
A 1+1 apartment in the Spitali quarter of Durrës, a settled residential area within easy reach of the city's main services.

The net area is 73 m²: a living room with kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom and a balcony, on the sixth floor. The cubic measurement is registered correctly and the mortgage documentation is in order.

Seventy-three square metres net for a one-bedroom is unusually generous — most 1+1 flats in Durrës sit between forty and sixty. The rooms here are proper rooms, and there is enough floor to work from home or take guests without the flat feeling crowded.

The building has no lift, and the flat is on the sixth floor. That is the honest reason a place this size is at this price, and it is the thing to decide about before anything else: it is a daily climb, and it makes the flat difficult for anyone with limited mobility. For someone who does not mind the stairs, the trade is a good one — space and quiet in central Durrës for the money a much smaller flat would take.
k2020: 1+1 and 2+1 apartments in Building 0.1, Qerret Residence, 250 m from the sea
k2021: New-build flats from €1,300/m² in a 20-block resort development at Qerret, with underground parking, a hotel and on-site services.
k2022:
Apartments under construction at Qerret, two hundred and fifty metres from the sea, in one of the most popular coastal areas of Durrës county.

The development is planned as twenty residential blocks with two underground parking levels and four residential floors each, alongside a hotel, and with bars, restaurants and services for residents inside the complex. This listing is Building 0.1, which has eight apartments per floor in 1+1 and 2+1 layouts on floors 1 to 5.

The 1+1 units are 59.9 m² gross and 51.3 m² net: a living room with kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. The 2+1 units are 76.5 m² gross and 65.5 m² net: a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms and one bathroom. All have a balcony, and the buildings have lifts and registered cubic measurement.

Prices start at €1,300 per square metre. Payment is in four instalments — 30%, 30%, 30% and a final 10% — spread over a term of up to six months, which is a fast schedule by Albanian standards and worth planning your funds around.

Two things to establish before committing: which building and which floor the quoted rate applies to, since €1,300/m² is the starting price and upper floors and sea-facing positions normally cost more; and the contractual handover date, in writing.
k2023: 1+1 and 2+1 apartments in Building A1, Qerret Residence, 250 m from the sea
k2024: Building A1 of the Qerret resort development: 13 flats per floor, one-bedrooms of 59.6 m² net and two-bedrooms of 73.8 m² net, from €1,300/m².
k2025:
Apartments under construction in Building A1 of the Qerret Residence, two hundred and fifty metres from the sea.

The development is planned as twenty residential blocks over two levels of underground parking, each with four residential floors, together with a hotel and with bars, restaurants and resident services inside the complex.

Building A1 has thirteen apartments per floor on floors 1 to 5. The 1+1 units are 68.4 m² gross and 59.6 m² net: a living room with kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. The 2+1 units are 84.6 m² gross and 73.8 m² net: a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms and one bathroom. Every unit has a balcony; there are lifts and the cubic measurement is registered.

Compared with Building 0.1 of the same development, A1's layouts are roughly eight square metres larger in each type — a real difference in a one-bedroom. Thirteen flats per floor, on the other hand, means a longer corridor and more units facing inland, so ask which positions on the plan are still free.

Prices start at €1,300/m², paid in four instalments of 30%, 30%, 30% and 10% within up to six months. Confirm which floor and orientation the quoted rate applies to, and get the handover date into the contract.
k2026: 1+1 and 2+1 apartments in Building A2, Qerret Residence, 250 m from the sea
k2027: Building A2 at Qerret, the twin of A1: 13 flats per floor, one-bedrooms of 59.6 m² net and two-bedrooms of 73.8 m² net, from €1,300/m².
k2028:
Apartments under construction in Building A2 of the Qerret Residence, two hundred and fifty metres from the sea.

A2 is built to the same plan as Building A1: thirteen apartments per floor on floors 1 to 5, in two layouts. The 1+1 units are 68.4 m² gross and 59.6 m² net, with a living room and kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom; the 2+1 units are 84.6 m² gross and 73.8 m² net, with a living room and kitchen, two bedrooms and one bathroom. All have balconies, the building has lifts and the cubic measurement is registered.

The wider development comprises twenty residential blocks over two underground parking levels, a hotel, and bars, restaurants and resident services on site.

Since A1 and A2 offer identical flats, the choice between them is about where each block stands on the site — nearer the beach side or the road, and what it looks onto. Ask for the site plan before choosing a building, not just the floor plan.

Prices start at €1,300/m², with payment in four instalments of 30%, 30%, 30% and 10% over up to six months. The rate for a specific floor and the contractual handover date should both be confirmed in writing.
k2029: 1+1 and 2+1 apartments in Building B3, Qerret Residence, with instalments
k2030: Building B3 at Qerret, 250 m from the sea: one-bedrooms of 58.8 m² net and two-bedrooms of 74 m² net, from €1,300/m² in four instalments.
k2031:
Apartments under construction in Building B3 of the Qerret Residence, two hundred and fifty metres from the sea.

The project comprises twenty residential blocks with two underground parking levels and four residential floors each, a hotel, and bars and restaurants within the complex.

Building B3 has thirteen apartments per floor on floors 1 to 5. The 1+1 units are 67.3 m² gross and 58.8 m² net: a living room with kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. The 2+1 units are 84.8 m² gross and 74 m² net: a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms and one bathroom. Balconies throughout, lifts, and registered cubic measurement.

The B-row layouts differ only marginally from those in A1 and A2 — the one-bedrooms are a square metre smaller, the two-bedrooms a fraction larger. What matters more is the block's position: the letter rows run back from the sea, so ask how far B3 stands behind the A buildings and whether its upper floors see over them.

Prices start at €1,300/m². Payment is 30%, 30%, 30% and 10% across a period of up to six months. As with every building in this development, confirm the rate for your chosen floor and the handover date in writing.
k2032: Two-storey house for two families on a 444 m² plot, near Hajdar Dushi School, Durrës
k2033: A private house with two self-contained floors of about 130 m² each — living room, kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom on both — a green yard and a large veranda.
k2034:
A private two-storey house in a quiet, well-liked residential area near the Hajdar Dushi School in Durrës, surrounded by greenery.

The plot is 444 m². Each floor is laid out as a complete home: the ground floor has a built area of 129.8 m² with a living room and kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom; the upper floor has 132 m² with the same arrangement. There is a large veranda, a green yard, and the cubic measurement is registered.

That symmetry is the point of the house. It suits two related households that want to live side by side with their own front doors, or one family that lives on one floor and lets the other. It also means about 260 m² of built space for the price, which in a settled part of Durrës is hard to find in any other form.

Worth checking on a viewing: whether the two floors have separate entrances and separate meters, since that decides how easily they can be used — or eventually sold — independently.
k2035: 2+1 of 70 m² with a lift and parking, Golem
k2036: A two-bedroom flat of 64.4 m² net on the fifth floor of a quiet, well-run residence in Golem that has its own parking.
k2037:
A 2+1 apartment in Golem, one of the most popular coastal areas of Durrës, in a quiet residence with good management.

The gross area is 70 m² and the net 64.4 m²: a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom and a balcony, on the fifth residential floor. The building has a lift, the residence offers parking, and the mortgage documentation is in order.

Two features here are worth more in Golem than they look on paper. Parking: in July and August the streets near the beach fill completely, and a space inside the residence is the difference between arriving and circling. Management: a residence that is actually administered keeps its common areas, lifts and gardens in order through the off-season, which is what holds a flat's value in a resort area.

The price is fair for a finished two-bedroom in this location, with nothing to wait for and nothing to build.
k2038: Furnished 2+1 of 78 m² with two balconies, Vollga, Durrës
k2039: A bright, furnished two-bedroom flat on the fourth floor with a lift, in Vollga — the seafront quarter of central Durrës.
k2040:
A 2+1 apartment in Vollga, Durrës — the promenade quarter, and one of the most sought-after addresses in the city for being on the sea and in the centre at once.

The area is 78.58 m²: a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom and two balconies, on the fourth floor of a building with a lift. It is sold furnished, and the flat gets natural light through the whole day.

Vollga is priced as what it is. The promenade, the port, the old town, cafés and the city's services are all on foot, and the market treats that combination as the top of Durrës. The figure per square metre here is well above Golem or Plazh, and buyers pay it for not needing a car for anything.

Two balconies on a flat this size usually means one to the front and one to the rear, which also helps the flat through the heat of summer. Ask which of them faces the sea.
k2041: Sea-view 1+1, 80 m from the beach, Plazh Iliria
k2042: A one-bedroom flat of 50.5 m² net with a sea view, on the fourth floor of a building with a lift and year-round management.
k2043:
A 1+1 apartment with a sea view at Plazh Iliria in Durrës, eighty metres from the water.

The gross area is 61 m² and the net 50.5 m²: a living room with kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom and a balcony, on the fourth floor. The building has a lift and is managed all year round, and the mortgage documentation is in order.

On this stretch of coast the phrase that matters is "all year round". Many beachfront blocks in Durrës are effectively shut from October to May — lifts switched off, common areas neglected. A managed building is one you can live in through the winter, and one where a flat let in summer is still in good order when the next season starts.

The quarter is quiet outside July and August. The flat works as a holiday base, as a seasonal rental — a sea-view one-bedroom eighty metres from the beach is the easiest kind of place to let here — or as a year-round home for someone who wants the sea at the door.
k2044: 1,500 m² plot on the main road with ownership certificate, Karpen, Kavajë
k2045: A titled plot of 1,500 m² directly on the main road at Karpen, near Kavajë — a clean, low-cost holding with road frontage.
